title: Plugin response envelope, contract v0
description: Every response a plugin writes to stdout: exactly one JSON object of this shape, and nothing else. ok is false when the verb failed; data is then null and warnings says why.

data.description: The verb's result; its schema depends on the verb (describe.schema.json, fact-refresh.schema.json, or the referenced report schema for merge).

notRead.description: Inputs the plugin was given and deliberately did not use, each with the reason.
